description: This is a PHP class named 'LeaveDecorator' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Entity\Decorator'. It provides methods to interact with and decorate a 'Leave' entity object, including setting employee and leave type references, formatting leave status, date, duration, start/end times, and retrieving the last comment related to the leave. It uses several traits and interacts with various entities in the OrangeHRM system, serving as a decorator pattern implementation for leave objects.

classes.name: LeaveDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for the Leave entity, providing methods to format and retrieve leave-related information, and to associate leave with employee and leave type references.

methods.name: getLeave
methods.description: Returns the underlying Leave entity object.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee to the Leave based on employee number.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeById
methods.description: Associates a LeaveType to the Leave based on leave type id.

methods.name: getLeaveStatus
methods.description: Returns the leave status as a human-readable string with proper casing.

methods.name: getLeaveStatusName
methods.description: Returns the leave status name in uppercase, as retrieved from the leave request service.

methods.name: getLeaveDate
methods.description: Returns the leave date formatted as 'Y-m-d'.

methods.name: getLeaveDuration
methods.description: Returns a human-readable leave duration based on the leave's duration type.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: If leave duration is specified by time, returns the start time formatted as 'H:i'.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: If leave duration is specified by time, returns the end time formatted as 'H:i'.

methods.name: getLastComment
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent comment associated with the leave.
